title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Gamliel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 22a and Avodah Zarah 34b he reports Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel. It appears that he is Rabbi Yehudah Nesiah [א)]; see his entry. Hyman reports that Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1, counts him among Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel's generation.

notes.text: The identification with Yehudah Nesiah is tentative, and the generation assigned by Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon is reported separately. The source’s marker א) is retained; it may designate a numbered cross-reference, so the marker alone does not establish that a footnote is missing.

Berakhot 22a and Avodah Zarah 34b both have Yehudah ben Gamliel reporting Chanina ben Gamliel. The Oxford Iggeret witness places Yehudah ben Gamla after Chanina ben Gamliel in the generation list. Hyman’s wording and tentative identification are retained.
